alerts.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s that the user is providing feedback on.
For each {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} given, a new {@link ReliabilityAssetAlertFeedback} is created.

category.description: The category of feedback that the user selected.

comment.description: Additional comments related to this feedback, possibly including a description of what might be the issue.

title: Spec used to create {@link ReliabilityAssetAlertFeedback} on form submit.
